page_title: BOC 1-3 EIN | Bochum v Eintracht Frankfurt 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 1 - 3 Goal! Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) scores after an assist by Ansgar Knauff that allowed him to tap in the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:3.
90+5' 17:17 – the total goal attempt statistics. 7:6 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
90+4' This is a yellow card! Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.

90+3' What a save from Kaua Santos! Dani de Wit (Bochum) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out. Golden chance! Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
90+1' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
88' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) releases a promising shot from the free kick on the edge of the box. His effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by Timo Horn.
87' Problems for Dino Toppmoller as Ellyes Skhiri is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Aurele Amenda (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces him.
86' Dieter Hecking decides to make a substitution. Ivan Ordets will be replaced by Cristian Gamboa (Bochum).
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Moritz Broschinski (Bochum) comes onto the pitch so that Matus Bero can be given a rest.
86' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Eintracht Frankfurt are about to take a free kick from a very dangerous position.
85' Matus Bero (Bochum) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
83' A sweet pass inside the box gives Myron Boadu (Bochum) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
82' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Timo Horn makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
81' That looked a certain handball by Tuta (Eintracht Frankfurt) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
80' Dino Toppmoller has decided to make a change. Nnamdi Collins (Eintracht Frankfurt) replaces Mario Gotze.
80' It's time for a substitution. Michy Batshuayi (Eintracht Frankfurt) comes on in place of Hugo Ekitike.
77' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
75' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
75' No offside! Referee Felix Zwayer points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Bochum players.
74' Wait! Referee Felix Zwayer has indicated he is going to review the Bochum goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

73' 1 - 2 What a beautiful moment! Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way inside the left post. Kaua Santos just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:2.
72' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just over the bar. That would have been a great goal!
71' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) has a sight of goal and shoots towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a superb save.
70' Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt) launches a cross from the corner, but Timo Horn is alert to thwart the effort.

70' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball goes out for a corner. Eintracht Frankfurt can continue in their attacking effort.
69' Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
67' Eintracht Frankfurt force a corner. They send men into the box.

67' Wow, what an escape. Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball is out of play. Eintracht Frankfurt will have a chance to score from a corner.
66' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner which is cleared.

65' Kaua Santos makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the right-hand post by Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) after a cross from the side. The linesman makes the right call and Bochum will have a corner.
65' Jean-Matteo Bahoya comes off the pitch to be replaced by Fares Chaibi (Eintracht Frankfurt).
63' Dieter Hecking prepares a substitution. Felix Passlack is replaced by Gerrit Holtmann (Bochum).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Georgios Masouras leaves the pitch and Myron Boadu (Bochum) comes on.
63' Here's the latest number of offsides – 6:1.
63' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) was quite harsh and Felix Zwayer didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
61' A dangerous looking corner kick from Matus Bero (Bochum) is cleared to safety by the defence.

61' Great save! Georgios Masouras (Bochum) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Kaua Santos. Now Bochum have a corner.
60' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
59' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Kaua Santos, who smothers the ball.
56' Matus Bero (Bochum) fails to deliver a decent cross from the corner and the ball goes out of play.
55' The resulting free kick from Matus Bero (Bochum) ends up in the gloves of the keeper.
55' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. A free kick has been awarded to Bochum.
55' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) commits a foul and Felix Zwayer immediately signals a free kick.
53' Felix Passlack (Bochum) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Eintracht Frankfurt.
51' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Felix Passlack (Bochum) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
50' Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends a cross into the box, but Timo Horn comes off his line to gather the ball.
49' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
49' Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find Hugo Ekitike with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
46' Half-time substitution. Dino Toppmoller decided to make a change. Hugo Larsson is replaced by Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Georgios Masouras (Bochum) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is caught offside once again.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Dani de Wit (Bochum) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
43' A clumsy foul by Matus Bero (Bochum) and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle.
41' Dieter Hecking is forced to make a change. Tom Krauss is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Dani de Wit (Bochum).
41' Jean-Matteo Bahoya slings over a decent looking cross towards Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.
40' The free kick from Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) failed to provide any scoring opportunity, as one of the defenders did a good job and knocked it out.
38' The game is interrupted now, Tom Krauss (Bochum) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
38' Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul after Matus Bero (Bochum) hacks down one of his opponents. Eintracht Frankfurt will take a free kick.
37' Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) attempts to find Hugo Larsson, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
36' Eintracht Frankfurt control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
34' 9:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 3:3.
33' Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
32' 0 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Hugo Ekitike is the provider as he slips the ball to Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt) who simply steers it home from close range. It's 0:2.
29' Ivan Ordets (Bochum) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
29' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.

29' Felix Passlack (Bochum) received a pass inside the box and sent a dangerous shot in on goal, but keep the champagne on ice as one of the defenders stepped in and blocked the effort. It's hard to say whether the keeper would have stopped it. The linesman points to the corner flag, Bochum are going to take it.
27' 0 - 1 Goal! Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 0:1.

27' Timo Horn was forced into action to thwart Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
27' Georgios Masouras (Bochum) is caught offside yet again.
25' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Rasmus Kristensen (Eintracht Frankfurt) but poses no threat.

25' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the left post.
23' Tom Krauss (Bochum) receives a harsh yellow card from the referee after committing a minor foul on his opponent.
21' A pass lands at the feet of Nathaniel Brown (Eintracht Frankfurt) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.

21' Hugo Ekitike nearly gets in a one-on-one with the goalkeeper after a defence-splitting pass from Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt), but one of the defenders makes a clearance to snuff out the chance.
20' A goal, which was scored by Georgios Masouras (Bochum), was disallowed due to offside.
17' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
17' Matus Bero (Bochum) prepares to take a corner kick.

17' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes a first-time shot inside the box after latching onto a nice lofted pass, but the effort is blocked and spins away to safety. Matus Bero (Bochum) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the bottom right corner, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Kaua Santos. What a save!
16' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
16' The total number of attempts is 5:1. The current number of shots on goal is 2:0.
14' Hugo Ekitike almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
12' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.

11' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the right side of the goal. Kaua Santos displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
11' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
10' Felix Passlack (Bochum) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Bochum.

9' Maximilian Wittek sends a lovely lofted pass forward that flies over the top of the defence and into the path of Ivan Ordets (Bochum), but he can't direct his header on target as it flies well wide of the left post.
9' Matus Bero (Bochum) takes the corner but it's cleared.
6' Jakov Medic (Bochum) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header just wide of the right post.
6' Corner kick. Matus Bero (Bochum) is ready to send the ball into the box.

5' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Matus Bero (Bochum) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Kaua Santos pulls off a brilliant save. Bochum will take a corner kick.

5' Oscar Hojlund (Eintracht Frankfurt) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
3' Matus Bero (Bochum) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Bochum will have the kick-off.
We have just got the news that the match will be delayed due to technical problems.
Felix Zwayer is the one to supervise the game today.
